title: Flights and Tandoor
description: Health, backups, resources and logs of AirTrail and Tandoor.

panels.description: From the Docker state and healthcheck of the container.

panels.title: Online
panels.description: A check of the tailnet address each minute. This tests DNS, Tailscale, TLS and the application.

panels.title: Last 26h
panels.description: Successful backups in the last 26 hours. The job runs each day, so 0 means that a backup was missed.

panels.title: Starts, 7d
panels.description: Times that the app container started in the last 7 days, from a deploy or a crash.

panels.title: DB errors
panels.description: Database errors in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Backups per day
panels.description: Each bar is a successful backup. A gap means that a backup did not run.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: 1.0 is one full core.

panels.title: Network, through Tailscale
panels.description: The app shares the network of this sidecar, so this shows app traffic and Tailscale traffic.

panels.title: App logs
panels.description: The app logs little in normal use, so this panel can be empty.
